_note: OFFLINE TEST FIXTURE. An abstract beat sheet of the kind extract_structure() produces. It carries no phrasing and no claims from any source video — which is the whole point of the structure/content separation. Used to exercise the rewrite + compliance + packet path without API calls.
topic: I have not been to a dentist in years and I am embarrassed

beats.name: hook
beats.function: Says out loud the thing the viewer has been privately avoiding, so they feel identified rather than caught.
beats.device: names a shame the viewer has not admitted, in the first person

beats.name: tension
beats.function: Confirms the fear is real and common rather than dismissing it, which buys permission to keep talking.

beats.name: turn
beats.function: Reframes what the viewer assumed the professional was thinking about them.
beats.device: reveals the insider perspective the viewer cannot see

beats.name: evidence
beats.function: Gives one concrete, checkable detail that makes the reframe credible rather than merely kind.

beats.name: payoff
beats.function: Lowers the cost of the first step so it stops feeling like a commitment.
beats.device: shrinks the ask to something smaller than the viewer expected

beats.name: cta
beats.function: Invites without pressure and gives the viewer a reason to pass it to someone else.
beats.device: addresses the person watching on behalf of someone they love

structure.hook_mechanism: Opens on an admission rather than a question, so the viewer recognises themselves before deciding whether to keep watching.
structure.retention_device: The viewer wants to know what the professional actually thinks of them, which is only answered at the turn.
structure.share_trigger: A viewer sends this to a partner or parent they have been quietly nagging to book an appointment, because it makes the point for them without sounding like nagging.
